name: Flutterwave Incorporated
note: Payments technology company behind the Send App remittance platform. Its named investors are venture capital and private firms — B Capital Group (lead), Alta Park Capital, Whale Rock Capital, Lux Capital, Avenir Growth, Tiger Global, Glynn Capital, Green Visor and Salesforce Ventures (TechCrunch, Feb 2022) — with no state or state fund among them.
